messages:
alex: Customer (tenant=acme-inc) opened a ticket — their frontend SDK shows 'Invalid API key' and user-facing 401, but when we reprobed the raw API we got a 403. They insist the key is valid and not rotated. Repro steps below. Can eng confirm whether this is auth or entitlement?

maria: Thanks — can you paste the exact curl you tried and the full response body (headers+body)? Also need the request id from their logs.

alex: Curl I used:```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_ABC123" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":"hello"}'
```
Response (headers trimmed):```http
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
Request-Id: rq_01H8Z...
WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm=\"redwood\"

{
  "error": {
    "code": "plan_gate",
    "message": "feature 'embeddings' requires plan 'pro' (current: free)",
    "meta": {"required_plan":"pro","current_plan":"free"}
  }
}```
Customer SDK log: `Error: Invalid API key` (SDK maps 403+WWW-Authenticate to auth error, which is the confusion).

samir: That header is the smoking gun. Our SDK interprets any 403 with `WWW-Authenticate` as credential issue. We intentionally set that header for auth failures but entitlement middleware is also adding it. Who owns entitlement middleware?

jordan: Eng-platform owns entitlement checks. I can pull entitlement service logs for that request id.

alex: Request-Id is rq_01H8Z... and tenant id acme-inc. Customer said billing email bounced last week — possible downgrade.

jordan: Pulled logs:```text
2026-03-10T14:22:01Z INFO plan-check tenant=acme-inc feature=embeddings result=DENIED reason=missing_plan required=pro current=free request_id=rq_01H8Z...
2026-03-10T14:22:01Z DEBUG entitlement-middleware adding header WWW-Authenticate=Bearer realm=\"redwood\"
```
So entitlement middleware is reusing the auth header when it returns a 403. That causes SDKs to surface it as an auth error.

maria: Oof. Customer sees 'invalid key' and Support escalates to Security/SRE. UX is bad. Short term fix suggestions?

samir: Short-term mitigation: update the SDK to check response body `error.code == 'plan_gate'` and map to a clearer message like `Entitlement required: upgrade plan`. But we shouldn't rely on SDK patch alone.

jordan: Long-term: entitlement service should not set `WWW-Authenticate` for non-auth 403s. Also add a distinct error code and HTTP header to make machine detection simpler, e.g., `X-Entitlement-Reason: missing_plan:pro`. Current body already has `code: plan_gate` but some older SDKs don't parse it.

alex: Customer asked for next steps — they want access now. Can we provide a temporary workaround?

jordan: Temporary options: 1) grant a one-off entitlement flag (feature_flag: embeddings=true) for acme-inc; 2) issue an upgrade coupon / manually move them to pro; 3) ask them to use an alternate key tied to a pro tenant. I can flip a flag but need approval from billing.

maria: Billing-bot — can you confirm acme-inc billing status?

billing-bot: Tenant acme-inc: billing_status=PAST_DUE, last_invoice=2026-02-28, current_plan=free, auto-downgrade=true. No active pro subscription.

alex: Customer says they accidentally had a credit card expiry. They're asking for a 48-hour lift so they can finish onboarding.

samir: If billing agrees, we can add a transient entitlement for 48h. I'll prepare the entitlement toggle script:```bash
# add transient entitlement for tenant
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/entitlements/toggle \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer internal_SVC_KEY" \n  -d '{"tenant":"acme-inc","feature":"embeddings","ttl":"48h","reason":"support one-off"}'
```
I will run it once billing confirms.

jordan: I'll open a PR to remove `WWW-Authenticate` for plan-gate 403s and add `X-Entitlement-Reason` header. Small change, low risk. Canary to prod in 24h.

maria: Feature requests: update public API docs to call out plan-gate with sample responses and recommended SDK behavior. Also notify SDK teams to handle `plan_gate` explicitly.

alex: Customer approved the transient entitlement if billing allows. Billing team — can you OK a 48h grace?

billing-bot: Approval from finance required for write access; pinged @finance. If finance approves, we can set a manual grace.

maria: I'll coordinate with finance. Meanwhile open a support note to customer explaining root cause: "This was not an invalid API key — it was a plan entitlement check that our SDK displayed as an auth error. We're applying a 48-hour grace while we fix the header and update SDKs." Include repro steps and the request id.

samir: Postmortem action items I'm tracking: [1] remove WWW-Authenticate on plan-gate (jack) [2] add X-Entitlement-Reason header (jordan) [3] update SDK parsing for plan_gate (sdk-team) [4] docs update & customer notification (maria) [5] add regression test to ensure entitlement 403s aren't mapped to auth errors (eng-testing).

jordan: PR opened: https://git.redwood/entitlement/merge/452 — small change. Will canary tomorrow.

alex: I'll update the ticket with the temporary workaround and the plan. Thanks all, closing loop once finance confirms the 48h grant. :thumbsup:
